chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Import of Reconditioned/ Second Hand Aircraft Spares
text: 2.39 Import of Reconditioned/ Second Hand Aircraft Spares Import Authorisation for reconditioned / second hand aircraft spares is not required subject to NOC/ recommendation of Director General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), Government of India.
